description: Write what you just did on this page to a JSON recipe on this machine, so the NEXT run replays it instead of rediscovering it. Call it with just a name and it builds the recipe from what this session actually filled: the fields (by accessible name, with the cssPath as fallback), the uploads, and the control you clicked to move on — folded into steps, since a click after a group of fills is what ends a step of a wizard. Pass `steps` yourself to write a recipe by hand, or to correct one. Do this at the END of any flow that took more than a few calls — a long multi-step form, a signup, a wizard — and say so in one line to the human: the recipe is a file they own, at the path this returns, editable and deletable by hand. Local only: writes a file, touches no browser, needs no consent.

name.description: A name you will recognise later, e.g. "new initiative form" — the file is named after it

notes.description: Anything the replay should know that the fields do not say — a precondition, a role to be signed in as, a step that only appears sometimes

project.description: Which product or client this flow belongs to. It becomes a FOLDER, and it is what qa_suite_run groups by. Host is not enough on its own: staging and production are two hosts and one project, and two products behind one domain are one host and two projects.

steps.description: Write the steps explicitly instead of deriving them from this session

advance.description: The control that moves to the next step — Next, Continue, Save

action.description: How to set it. `date` replays through qa_pick_date (value dd/mm/yyyy), `path` through qa_pick_path (levels separated by ">"); both are what a written value cannot do.

kind.description: What the classifier judged this control to be — "date-sections", "checkable-tree", "select-trigger". Stamped automatically when the recipe is built from this session; it is what stops the next run rediscovering that a calendar cannot be typed into.

name.description: The field's accessible name — the durable key across runs

role.description: Snapshot role, to disambiguate a name shared by a label and a control

selector.description: cssPath fallback, used when no name matches

tags.description: Labels for picking a subset later — ["smoke"], ["billing","regression"]. A suite can be run by tag instead of by name.

url.description: The flow's starting URL. Defaults to the page of the last snapshot; used to scope the journal to this host and to remind you where to start.

name: qa_recipe_save
title: Save the flow you just drove, as a replayable recipe
